Source and caveats ↗
SOURCE RECORD / S-BIAD1057

What you’re looking at.

Fixed fluorescence from a mouse blastomere compaction study. The opening image projects 14 sampled planes from one 61-plane TIFF. Scrolling separates seven of those same measured planes. This is not a live embryo recording or a prediction.

Measurement

The CSV holds per-plane, per-channel means and 99th percentiles from the original 16-bit pixels. Color, contrast and crop are display settings, not stain assignments. Plane positions are ordinal, not calibrated depths.
